prompt: Errors doubled after the deploy, so they rolled back first and debugged afterwards.
tells: rolled back first and debugged afterwards
trap: Observability helps later; the first move is rollback.

prompt: Any release can be reverted to the previous version with one command.
tells: reverted to the previous version with one command
why: Fast, practised rollback cuts recovery time.
trap: Blue-green is one way; the clue is the revert.

prompt: Rollback failed because the new release had already dropped a column the old code needed.
why: Irreversible migrations block rollback. Change schema in safe steps.
trap: It's a deploy problem, but the lesson is keeping rollback possible.

prompt: The team measures mean time to recover, and rollback is their fastest tool.
why: Rolling back is the quickest recovery.
trap: SLOs set targets; rollback restores service.

prompt: Instead of rolling back, they spent two hours writing a fix while users saw errors.
tells: spent two hours writing a fix
why: Rolling back would have restored service faster.
trap: The fix might work, but recovery comes first.

prompt: Turning the feature flag off restored the old behaviour in seconds.
why: A flag can be the fastest rollback.
trap: It's configuration, but used to roll back.
